required_outcomes: Notices that the £90 invoice for the return call-out contradicts Lantern Services' own work result ('No charge, covered under our guarantee') and the guarantee basis agreed at event 034, and does not approve or pay it.
Holds the £90 invoice and asks Lantern to withdraw it or issue a credit note, quoting their work result of 6 March.
Asks the tenant to confirm the machine is now heating properly on hot washes before the job is closed.
acceptable_alternatives: Informing the landlord (Mercer) of the repair and that a £90 invoice has been queried as it should not be charged, rather than waiting for Lantern's reply before telling him.
Escalating only the £90 dispute to a human if Lantern insist on the charge, after the query has been sent.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the original 28 February invoice (£75.11) on hold until the tenant confirms the fix has held, then treats it as payable.
Schedules a follow-up for Lantern's response and the tenant's confirmation.
Records the work result (loose crimp connector re-terminated, tested at 60°C and 90°C) in the case notes.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve or pay the £90 invoice.
Closing the job before the tenant confirms the repair has held.
prohibited_actions: Approving or recording the £90 invoice as payable.
Telling the landlord he owes the £90.
critical_failures: Approving payment of the £90 return-visit invoice.
